title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Internship in Gandhinagar
description:
As a search engine optimization (SEO) intern at Doodosoft, you will have the opportunity to work with a dynamic team to boost our online visibility and drive traffic to our website through Google Analytics and other SEO strategies. Your role will be vital in helping us reach our target audience and increase our online presence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct keyword research and analysis to identify trends and opportunities for optimization.
* Optimize website content, including meta tags, headers, and on-page content, to improve search engine rankings.
* Monitor and analyze website performance using Google Analytics to track key metrics and make data-driven decisions.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement new SEO strategies and initiatives.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest SEO trends and algorithms to ensure our website remains competitive in search engine results.
* Assist in link-building efforts to increase domain authority and drive organic traffic.
* Provide regular reports and updates on SEO performance to the team and suggest areas for improvement.

If you are passionate about SEO and eager to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment, this internship is perfect for you. Join us at Doodosoft and make a real impact on our digital marketing efforts!
  
  
About Company: We are a trusted website development company in India with over 6 years of experience serving clients across the globe. We specialize in website design, website redesign, graphic design, website SEO, hosting setup, and social media marketing to help businesses achieve a strong and effective digital presence.

title: Head – Brand & Marketing
description:
**Experience: 10-15 yrs**
**Location: GIFT City, Gandhinagar**
**Qualification: Graduate (MBA in Marketing preferred)**
**Role Overview**
The Head – Brand & Marketing will own DRC’s brand and the company’s marketing strategy across IT Services and IT Product portfolios. The role includes brand building, brand awareness, brand voice and the annual brand theme, B2B and B2C marketing, demand generation, performance and digital marketing, product marketing, content strategy, social media, and end-to-end ownership of offline marketing, including the organization’s annual event roadmap, industry conferences, tradeshows, webinars, exhibitions, customer events, and internal branding initiatives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Brand & Awareness
  
  

* Define and own DRC’s brand voice, tone, visual identity and brand guidelines across all channels.
* Create and drive an annual brand theme, with campaigns, content and events built around it.
* Build brand awareness among enterprise buyers and in the SMB and consumer segments DRC targets; manage brand perception through analyst, media, award, partner and listing-led visibility.
* Build and maintain consistent brand positioning across all marketing channels.

Strategy, Demand Generation & Product Marketing
  
  

* Develop and execute end-to-end marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Lead B2B demand generation campaigns to strengthen the sales pipeline, and lead B2C / SMB marketing for product offerings with separate funnels, messaging and KPIs.
* Develop and execute marketing strategies for IT Services and IT Product offerings, including go-to-market (GTM) plans and product positioning, launches, pricing and packaging inputs, and customer proof such as case studies and reviews.

Performance, Digital & Social Media
  
  

* Own performance and paid marketing (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta and others) with accountability for budgets, CPL/CAC, conversion funnels and pipeline contribution.
* Manage SEO and SEM end to end, including keyword strategy, technical and on-page SEO, content-led organic growth and paid search.
* Own social media strategy across LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, X and Facebook, covering content calendar, community engagement, leadership visibility and employer branding.
* Drive email marketing campaigns.

Content & Sales Enablement
  
  

* Oversee content marketing, including blogs, case studies, whitepapers, brochures, presentations, and sales collateral.
* Collaborate with Sales and Leadership teams to create effective sales enablement materials.

Offline Marketing & Events
  
  

* Own offline marketing end to end: event selection, budgeting, booth and collateral design, vendor management, on-ground execution, lead capture and post-event follow-up with Sales, with ROI reporting per event.
* Prepare and manage the annual marketing and event calendar, including conferences, exhibitions, webinars, product launches, partner events, and internal branding initiatives.

Analytics, Budgets & Team
  
  

* Track campaign performance using marketing analytics and CRM tools, ensuring maximum ROI.
* Identify market trends, competitive insights, and new business opportunities.
* Manage marketing budgets, external agencies, and vendor relationships.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the marketing team, and build its structure across content, design, performance and events as the portfolio grows.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (MBA preferred).
* 10–15 years of experience in B2B technology marketing, with exposure to B2C / SMB or product-led marketing preferred, with mandatory experience in both IT Services and IT Product companies.
* Strong understanding of IT solutions, including Web, Mobile, Cloud, AI, and Enterprise Applications.
* Proven expertise in demand generation, brand management, product marketing, performance marketing, and digital marketing.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Search Console, SEMrush/Ahrefs or similar marketing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience building or refreshing a brand voice and identity, and running tradeshows or large events end to end.
* Excellent communication, content writing, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience measuring campaign performance and marketing ROI.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in managing teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

Must-Have Requirement
  
  
Mandatory experience in both IT Services and IT Product marketing. Candidates with experience in only one domain will not be considered.

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Comdt Ranjan's SSB Academy is a training institution focused on preparing individuals for Services Selection Board (SSB) examinations and careers in the armed forces. The academy offers structured guidance, mentoring, and practical training to help candidates build confidence, leadership, and communication skills. It emphasizes discipline, integrity, and holistic development in a supportive learning environment. Team members at the academy contribute to building a strong brand presence that reflects its values and commitment to aspirants.
  
**Role Description**
The Social Media Assistant is a full-time, on-site role based in Gandhinagar. This position involves supporting the academy’s online presence by creating and publishing content across social media platforms, monitoring engagement, and responding to basic queries or comments in a timely and professional manner. The Social Media Assistant will help plan and schedule posts, collect photos and videos from ongoing training activities, and ensure content aligns with the academy’s brand and goals. The role includes coordinating with trainers and administrative staff for updates, tracking basic performance metrics, and suggesting ideas to improve reach and engagement.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Writing skills.
* Candidates should possess Social Media and Social Media Content Creation skills.
* Candidates should possess Social Media Marketing skills and an understanding of online engagement.
* Basic knowledge of design tools or video editing software is beneficial.
* Attention to detail, reliability, and the ability to work collaboratively on-site in Gandhinagar.
* Prior experience in social media management, marketing, or content assistance is an advantage.

description:

From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners to make a personalized statement through ,customization.
 



 While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
 



 For more about Group Bayport, please visit
 



**Website:**

**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager\- Product Innovation \& Fabric Expert**

**About the Role** 




 To lead product innovation and fabric development initiatives for the Covers category by improving product aesthetics, functionality, durability, and customer experience through advanced fabric research, innovative stitching techniques, accessories development, and product engineering. The role will be responsible for repositioning the entire Covers portfolio by identifying best\-in\-class fabrics, optimizing product construction, and introducing innovative design features that enhance perceived value while maintaining cost competitiveness.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Product Design \& Aesthetic Enhancement

* Develop innovative stitching patterns and construction methods to improve product appearance.
* Improve product fit, shape retention, and premium look.
* Introduce design elements that enhance customer perception and usability.
* Standardize product finishing specifications across categories.
* Improve packaging and presentation of finished products.



  





 2\. Accessories \& Trim Innovation
 



 • Develop and evaluate accessories such as:
 



 o Buckles
 



 o Straps
 



 o Drawcords
 



 o Elastic systems
 



 o Velcro closures
 



 o Air vents
 



 o Handles
 



 o Reinforcement patches
 



 o Branding elements
 



  





 • Identify opportunities to improve functionality and aesthetics through trims and hardware.
 



  





 3\. Fabric Research \& Development
 


* Lead fabric innovation programs for all cover categories.
* Evaluate lighter\-weight fabrics without compromising durability.
* Develop category\-wise fabric strategy based on:



  





 o Weather resistance
 



 o UV resistance
 



 o Water repellency
 



 o Breathability
 



 o Strength
 



 o Cost
 



 o Customer expectations
 



  





 • Benchmark global fabric suppliers and technologies.
 



 • Develop alternative fabric sourcing strategies to reduce cost and improve performance.
 



 • Work with suppliers on new coating and finishing technologies.
 



  





 4\. Product Engineering \& Testing
 



  





 • Define performance standards for each category.
 



 • Conduct testing for:
 



 o UV resistance
 



 o Waterproofness
 



 o Tear strength
 



 o Abrasion resistance
 



 o Color fastness
 



 o Weathering performance
 



  





 • Establish product validation protocols before commercialization.
 



 • Create technical specifications and BOM standards.
 



  





 5\. Competitive Benchmarking
 



  





 • Benchmark leading brands in:
 



 o Outdoor covers
 



 o Furniture covers
 



 o Grill covers
 



 o Equipment covers
 



 o Automotive covers
 



  




* Identify innovation trends and customer pain points.
* Recommend product upgrades based on market intelligence.



  





 6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 



 • Work closely with:
 



 o Design Team
 



 o Sourcing Team
 



 o Manufacturing Team
 



 o Quality Team
 



 o Product Management Team
 


* Support pilot runs and commercialization of new products.
* Drive innovation projects from concept to production launch.



  





**Key Deliverables (First 12 Months)** 




  





**Product Enhancement** 



* Complete review of entire Covers portfolio.
* Develop category\-wise premium product positioning strategy.
* Launch improved construction standards for all key categories.



  





**Fabric Development** 




  





 Identify and validate lighter\-weight fabric alternatives.
 



 Develop fabric matrix for each cover category.
 



 Deliver minimum 3–5 new fabric innovations.
 



  





**Innovation Pipeline** 




  





 Launch minimum 10 product improvement initiatives.
 



 Reduce product weight while maintaining performance standards.
 



 Improve customer satisfaction related to fit, appearance, and functionality.
 



  





**Cost \& Value Improvement** 




  





 Improve value perception without increasing product cost significantly.

**Key Requirements:** 




**Education** 




 • B.Tech / B.E. Textile Technology

 • Apparel Technology
 



 • Product Engineering
 



  





**Experience** 



* 10–15\+ years experience in:



  




* Technical textiles
* Outdoor products
* Protective covers
* Furniture covers
* Automotive covers
* Home furnishing products
* Product development



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Fabric development and sourcing
* Sewing engineering
* Pattern development
* Technical textiles
* Product testing
* Product innovation
* Vendor development
* Cost engineering



  





**Desired Industry Background** 




 Preferred from:

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.
